demos.title: 太阳系轨道
demos.hint: 日心/螺旋前进 · 卫星 · 缩放聚焦
demos.desc: 着色器太阳+日冕、程序化行星与光环、30 颗卫星；可缩放聚焦，并切换太阳前进的螺旋轨迹模式。
demos.hint_en: Day / Helix Forward · Satellite · Scale Focus
demos.desc_en: Colored Sun + Coron, Programmatic Planets and Halo-rings, 30 satellites; able to zoom in and switch the spiral pattern of the Sun forward.

demos.title: 旋转立方体
demos.desc: 基础场景、光照与线框。
demos.desc_en: Basic scenes, light and line frames.

demos.title: 环绕视角与灯光
demos.hint: 拖拽旋转 · 滚轮缩放
demos.desc: OrbitControls 与多光源。
demos.desc_en: OrbitControls with Multilight.

demos.title: 粒子场
demos.desc: Points 粒子场与鼠标交互。
demos.desc_en: Points particle field interacts with mouse.

demos.title: 几何体画廊
demos.desc: 内置几何体与射线拾取。
demos.desc_en: Inside geometry and Establishment.

demos.title: 波浪地形
demos.desc: 顶点动画生成地形。
demos.desc_en: Top-point animation generates terrain.

demos.title: 小人动画
demos.hint: 程序化角色 · 摆臂动画
demos.desc: 层级模型与骨骼式动画。
demos.desc_en: Level model and bone animation.

demos.title: 着色器变形球
demos.hint: 自定义顶点/片元着色器
demos.desc: ShaderMaterial 变形球体。
demos.desc_en: ShaderMaterial Transforming Sphere/12.

demos.title: 晶格
demos.desc: 用三重循环 i、j、k 在 x、y、z 三个方向各放 n 个小方块，就得到一个立方晶格（像盐的晶体结构）。
demos.desc_en: Triple cycle i, j, K In x, y, z put n blocks in each of the three directions and get a cubic crystal (a crystal structure like salt).

demos.title: 环带
demos.desc: 圆环（甜甜圈）可以看成一个半径为 r 的小圆，绕着距离 R 的轴转一圈扫出来的曲面。
demos.desc_en: The circle can be seen as a small circle with a radius of r, which turns around the axis from R.

demos.title: 星云球
demos.desc: 把球面按经线、纬线切成 N×N 格，每个格点放一个发光的点，就成了“星云球”。
demos.desc_en: Cut the surface by the longitude, the latitude N×N Greg, put a light spot on each grid, and it's done“Nebula Sphere”。

demos.title: 多立方
demos.desc: 第 i 个方块的角度 θᵢ = 2πi/n。
demos.desc_en: I don't think so i Angle of diamonds θᵢ = 2πi/n。

demos.title: 螺旋柱
demos.desc: 参数 u 从 0 走到 1，x、z 绕圆转 k 圈，同时 y 均匀上升 h。
demos.desc_en: Parameter u from 0 to 1,x, z circle k while y evenly rise h.

demos.title: 玻璃球
demos.desc: MeshPhysicalMaterial 的 transmission（透射）让光穿过物体，ior（折射率）…
demos.desc_en: The transmission of MeshPhysicalMaterial lets light through the object, ior (refraction rate)

demos.title: 线框球
demos.desc: 正二十面体有 20 个三角形面。
demos.desc_en: Twenties have 20 triangles.

demos.title: 批量实例方块
demos.desc: 用一份几何体一次画出成百上千个方块，每个方块只记自己的位置和颜色，所以数量很多也不卡。
demos.desc_en: Hundreds of squares are drawn at once with a geometry, each of which only remembers its own location and colour, so many are not allowed to fit.

demos.title: 起伏面
demos.desc: 往平静的水里丢一颗石子，波纹会从中心一圈圈向外扩散，而且越往外越弱。
demos.desc_en: Throwing a stone into the calm water will spread the ripples out of the centre and weaken.

demos.title: 点云环
demos.desc: 土星环由无数冰块组成，每块都像小卫星一样绕土星公转。
demos.desc_en: Saturn rings consist of numerous ice blocks, each of which rotate around Saturn like a small satellite.

demos.title: 光柱
demos.desc: CylinderGeometry 的上下半径可以不同，于是得到一个圆台（被削掉尖的圆锥）。
demos.desc_en: CylinderGeometry can have a different upper and lower radius, so it gets a circle (a cone that has been cut off).

demos.title: 反射地板
demos.desc: 把物体关于地面翻转复制一份放到地板下面，再让地板半透明，看起来就像地面映出了倒影。
demos.desc_en: A copy of the object relating to the ground flip was placed under the floor, which was then made transparent and looked like a reflection of the ground.

demos.title: 环结
demos.desc: 沿大圈方向绕 p 圈，同时沿管子绕 q 圈，就得到 (p, q) 环面纽结。
demos.desc_en: Circle around p in the direction of the large circle, and circle around the tube in the q circle, and get (p, q) ring tie.

demos.title: 卫星轨道
demos.desc: 周期的平方与轨道半径的立方成正比（开普勒第三定律），所以面板里 T²/r³ 对每颗卫星都一样。
demos.desc_en: The square of the cycle is proportional to the cube of the orbit radius, so it's in the panel T²/r³ For every satellite.

categories.name: 图表
categories.intro: 折线、柱状、饼图、雷达等常用统计图表及其交互。

demos.title: 折线图
demos.hint: 调颜色 · 张力 · 数据点
demos.desc: 把每个数据点按顺序连成线，看数值怎么随时间涨跌；可调平滑程度和虚线。
demos.desc_en: Connecting each data point in sequence to see how the values rise or fall over time; smoothing and dashing.

demos.title: 多序列折线
demos.desc: 多数据集折线对比。
demos.desc_en: Multi-data set retweeting.

demos.title: 面积图
demos.desc: 面积图 = 折线 + 下方填色，强调累计体量而不只是走势。
demos.desc_en: Area = Line + Filled below, highlighting cumulative volume rather than just movement.

demos.title: 阶梯折线
demos.desc: 阶梯折线：数值在下一个点之前保持不变，再突然跳变，适合表示档位、价格调整。
demos.desc_en: stairline: the value remains unchanged until the next point, then suddenly jumps and is suitable to represent the slot, Price adjustments.

demos.title: 柱状图
demos.hint: 柱宽 · 圆角 · 换数据
demos.desc: 柱高表示数值大小，类别排在横轴。
demos.hint_en: Column width · Rounded corner; fillet · Change Emphasizes
demos.desc_en: The height of the column indicates the numerical size, and the category is placed in a cross-axis.

demos.title: 横向柱图
demos.desc: 把柱横过来，类别名更易读，适合排名榜。
demos.desc_en: It's easier to read a column across, and it suits the ranking.

demos.title: 堆叠柱图
demos.desc: 一根柱里叠多种构成，总高是合计，颜色分段是部分。
demos.desc_en: A column has multiple compositions, the total height being a sum and the colour segment being a partial.

demos.title: 堆叠面积
demos.desc: 多层面积上下相叠，总高度是总和，颜色带表示各部分贡献。
demos.desc_en: The multidimensional build-up is stacked upwards and downs, the overall height is the sum, and the colour belts represent the contribution of each part.

demos.title: 分组柱图
demos.desc: 同一类别并排多根柱，直接比不同系列在该类别上的差异。
demos.desc_en: The same category is divided into multiple pillars, directly different from the different series in that category.

demos.title: 饼图
demos.desc: 圆被切成扇形，角度 ∝ 占比。
demos.desc_en: The circle is cut into a fan, the angles are poignant.

demos.title: 环形图
demos.desc: 环形图：中间挖空的饼图，每段弧长代表占比，中心可以放总数。
demos.desc_en: Circumference: The sum of the pies that are emptied in the middle, representing the proportion of each arc long, is available at the centre.

demos.title: 雷达图
demos.desc: 多个维度围成多边形，形状越满综合越强，适合能力模型。
demos.desc_en: Multiple dimensions are circumscribed into polygons, and the larger the shape, the stronger it is, the better it is for a capability model.

demos.title: 极坐标面积
demos.desc: 每瓣半径表示数值，角度均分，像雷达的「饼」版本。
demos.desc_en: Each valve radius represents the value, the angles are equal, like the radar "cake" version.

demos.title: 散点图
demos.desc: 每个点是一个样本的 (x,y)，看相关与离群点。
demos.desc_en: Each point is a sample (x,y) of the relevant and discrete points.

demos.title: 气泡图
demos.desc: 散点 + 半径表示第三变量，气泡越大该维越大。
demos.desc_en: The breakpoint + radius means the third variable, the greater the bubble, the greater the dimension.

demos.title: 混合图
demos.desc: 柱状图和折线图画在同一张图里：柱子看数量，折线看趋势。
demos.desc_en: The column chart and the line diagram are in the same picture: the column looks at the number and the line looks at the trend.

demos.title: 迷你折线
demos.desc: 迷你走势图：没有坐标轴的小折线，放在表格或卡片里一眼看出涨跌。
demos.desc_en: Mini-portrait: There are no small folds of the axis, which appear in the table or card at a glance.

demos.title: 仪表盘
demos.desc: 仪表盘：半个圆环当刻度，指针转到的角度 = 当前值占最大值的比例。
demos.desc_en: dashboard: Half a circle at a time, pointer to angle = current value as a proportion of maximum value.

demos.title: 进度环
demos.desc: 完整圆环表示 0~100% 完成度。
demos.desc_en: Full circle means 0~100% completion.

demos.title: 瀑布图
demos.desc: 从起点出发，每一步加减，最后落到终点，用来拆解利润变化。
demos.desc_en: From the point of departure, each step is added or reduced and ends up at the end, and is used to dismantle profit changes.

demos.title: 组合图
demos.desc: 组合图把柱与线（或面积）编在同一坐标系，适合仪表盘总览。
demos.desc_en: Combination diagrams have the same coordinate system of columns and lines (or areas) and are suitable for the dashboard overview.

demos.title: 对数折线
demos.desc: Logarithmic scale。
demos.desc_en: Logarithmic scale。

demos.title: 横向堆叠
demos.desc: Horizontal stacked。
demos.desc_en: Horizontal stacked。

demos.title: 密度柱
demos.desc: 很多细柱排在一起，像直方图，看出分布疏密。
demos.desc_en: A lot of fine columns lined up, like histograms, to see a dissipation.

demos.title: 实时流图
demos.desc: Realtime streaming。
demos.desc_en: Realtime streaming。

demos.title: 雷达对比
demos.desc: 两层雷达叠加，对比两组评分的覆盖差异。
demos.desc_en: Two layers of radar superimpose, comparing the coverage differences of the two sets.

demos.title: 图例环形
demos.desc: 环形图 + 右侧图例，会议投影时更清晰。
demos.desc_en: Ring + Right Legend, clearer when projecting.

demos.title: 柱线双轴
demos.desc: 双坐标轴：左边轴给柱子用，右边轴给折线用，两种单位不同的数据放一起比较。
demos.desc_en: Two-coordinate axes: the left axis is used for the column, the right axis is used for the fold, and the data are compared in two different units.

demos.title: 分离饼图
demos.desc: 分离饼图：把某一块扇形沿半径方向往外推，突出重点类别。
demos.desc_en: Dissociative pie charts: Push a piece of sector outward along the radius, highlighting the focus categories.

demos.title: 气泡矩阵
demos.desc: 气泡图：每个圆的面积代表数值大小，位置代表另外两个维度。
demos.desc_en: A bubble map: The area of each circle represents the numerical size and position represents the other two dimensions.

demos.title: 迷你柱列
demos.desc: 迷你柱列嵌在报表里，比数字更直观的近期波动。
demos.desc_en: The mini-column is embedded in the report, with more visible recent fluctuations than the numbers.

demos.title: 区间面积
demos.desc: 上下两条边界围成的带状区域，常表示置信区间或温度高低范围。
demos.desc_en: A banded area surrounded by two upper and lower borders often indicates a confidence interval or a high temperature range.

demos.title: 分类占比
demos.desc: 面向品类/渠道占比的饼图预设。
demos.desc_en: Text-oriented / A pre-set pie map of the channel share.

demos.title: 工作日对比
demos.desc: 周一到周日的分组对比，适合看工作日/周末差异。
demos.desc_en: Monday to Sunday group comparison for workdays / Weekend difference.

demos.title: KPI 环
demos.desc: KPI 环形进度：圆环填满的比例 = 完成值 ÷ 目标值，中间显示百分比。
demos.desc_en: KPI Ring Progress: The proportion of the circle filled = the completed value ÷ target value, with percentages shown in the middle.

demos.title: Canvas 迷你趋势
demos.desc: Canvas sparkline。
demos.desc_en: Canvas sparkline。

demos.title: Canvas 仪表
demos.desc: Canvas 仪表盘。
demos.desc_en: Canvas dashboard.

demos.title: Canvas 堆叠
demos.desc: Canvas 堆叠图。
demos.desc_en: Canvas stack.

categories.name: 界面组件
categories.intro: 后台常用组件的交互原理：按钮、卡片、弹层、轮播、分页等，画布复现几何与状态，悬停读数 + 中文讲解。

demos.title: 按钮
demos.desc: 按钮变体、尺寸与禁用态。
demos.desc_en: Button Variable, Size with Disable State.

demos.title: 卡片与弹窗
demos.desc: 卡片布局与模态框。
demos.hint_en: The card interacts with the ballistic layer
demos.desc_en: A card layout with a model frame.

demos.title: 输入控件
demos.desc: 文本框聚焦时边框变主色并出现光晕；校验失败显示红框与提示。
demos.desc_en: Text frames change the main colour and dizziness when the focus is on; red frames and tips are displayed when verification fails.

demos.title: 导航样式
demos.desc: 当前项用滑动指示器（下划线或胶囊）标出，指示器在项间平滑移动。
demos.desc_en: The current item is marked with a slide indicator (underlined or capsule), which moves smoothly between the items.

demos.title: 手风琴组件
demos.desc: 手风琴：点击标题展开这一块内容，高度平滑过渡，其他块自动收起。
demos.desc_en: accordion: Clicking on the title to expand this section, smoothing the transition height, and automatically closing the others.

demos.title: 对话框
demos.desc: 弹窗：在页面上盖一层半透明遮罩，中间弹出对话框，关闭后回到原页面。
demos.desc_en: Blank windows: Cover the page with a semi-transparent mask, pop up the middle dialogue box and return to the original page after closing.

demos.title: 走马灯组件
demos.desc: 轮播：一排卡片横向排列，按位置平滑滑动切换，圆点显示当前第几张。
demos.desc_en: Rotation: A row of cards is lateralized, smoothed by location, and the dot shows the current number.

demos.title: 轻提示 Toast
demos.hint: 顶部切换类型 · 触发
demos.desc: 新消息从角落滑入，旧消息依次下移并淡出，几秒后自动消失。
demos.desc_en: New news slipped from the corner, the old news moved down and faded out, and then disappeared in seconds.

demos.title: 下拉菜单
demos.desc: Dropdown/Select。
demos.desc_en: Dropdown/Select。

demos.title: 悬浮提示
demos.desc: Tooltip/Popover。
demos.desc_en: Tooltip/Popover。

demos.title: 加载占位
demos.desc: 骨架屏：内容加载前先显示灰色块勾勒布局，上面扫过一道亮光表示“正在加载”。
demos.desc_en: Bones screen: The contents are pre-mounted with a grey block twirl layout, with a sweep indicating that the light is “mounting”.

demos.title: 按钮动效
demos.hint: 顶部切换 · 点击反馈
demos.desc: 按钮微交互：按下时轻微缩小、松开回弹，让人感觉按钮“被按到了”。
demos.desc_en: Button Microinteract: Shrink slightly when pressing, Unleash the bounce and make you feel that the button "was pressed."

demos.title: 开关弹簧
demos.desc: 弹簧开关：滑块像挂在弹簧上，切换时先冲过头再回到位置。
demos.desc_en: Spring switch: The slider appears to be hanging on the spring, and the switch goes over and back to position.

demos.title: 底栏/浮层
demos.desc: 底部抽屉：面板从屏幕底部滑出，可以拖动把手调整高度或拉下关闭。
demos.desc_en: Bottom drawer: The panel slips out of the bottom of the screen and can drag the handle to adjust the height or pull it off.

demos.title: 标签页动效
demos.desc: 指示条滑动 Tabs。
demos.desc_en: Instruction slips Tabs.

demos.title: 时间线
demos.desc: 时间线：事件按时间顺序竖向排列，圆点和连线标出先后关系。
demos.desc_en: Timeline: Events are in chronological order vertically and dots and links indicate the sequence.

demos.title: 树形列表
demos.desc: 树形目录：文件夹可以展开、收起，子项按层级缩进显示。
demos.desc_en: Tree directory: folders can be expanded, closes, sub-items are shown by level indentation.

demos.title: 悬浮按钮 FAB
demos.desc: 主按钮旋转成 ×，子按钮依次弹出（竖排或扇形），带交错延迟。
demos.desc_en: Main button rotated to ×，sub-buttons with a staggered delay in subsequent ejection (dive or fan formation).

demos.title: 芯片/标签
demos.desc: 标签：小圆角块表示分类或筛选条件，点击可以选中或删除。
demos.desc_en: Label: Small corner blocks represent the classification or filter conditions, and click to select or delete.

demos.title: 表格交互
demos.desc: 表格交互：点表头排序、悬停高亮整行，长表格表头固定不动。
demos.desc_en: Table Interactive: Header Sorting, Suspends the high-lighted whole row, and the long table header is fixed.

demos.title: 头像组
demos.desc: 头像堆叠：多个圆形头像部分重叠排成一排，超出数量显示 “+N”。
demos.desc_en: Folding of heads: Multiple circle heads overlap in one row, exceeding the number shown for "+N".

demos.title: 步骤条动效
demos.desc: 当前步骤之前打勾，连接线随进度填充主色，当前节点外圈脉冲。
demos.desc_en: The current steps are preceded by a tick, the connection line fills the main colour with progress, and the current node outer circle pulse.

demos.title: 看板
demos.desc: Kanban 列布局。
demos.desc_en: Kanban Entity.

demos.title: 取色器
demos.desc: 色相环 + 预设色板。
demos.desc_en: Color ring + preset palette.

demos.title: 通知中心
demos.desc: 铃铛显示未读数并轻摇，面板列出通知，新通知从顶部插入，其余下移。
demos.desc_en: The bell displays unreading and shaking, the panel lists notifications, new notifications are inserted from the top and the rest moved down.

demos.title: 命令面板
demos.desc: 输入关键字逐字出现，结果列表实时过滤，高亮项上下移动，回车执行。
demos.desc_en: Enter the keyword word by word, the result list is filtered in real time, the highlight item moves up and down, and back to the car for execution.

demos.title: 分页器
demos.desc: 当前页高亮块滑动到目标页；页数多时中间折叠成 …，始终显示首尾页。
demos.desc_en: The current high-light block slides to the target page; the number of pages folds into... and always shows the end page.

demos.title: 面包屑
demos.desc: 显示当前页面在站点中的层级路径，末级为当前页；新层级从右侧滑入，悬停项加下划线。
demos.desc_en: Displays the hierarchy path of the current page in the site, with the last level as the current page; the new layer slides from the right side and the suspension is underlined.

demos.title: 评分星
demos.desc: 悬停预览分数（星星依次点亮放大），离开后回到当前分；支持半星。
demos.desc_en: Suspend preview fractions (the stars light up in turn) and then return to the current fractions; support half-stars.

demos.title: 空状态
demos.desc: 列表没有数据时，用一幅轻微浮动的插画 + 说明文字 + 引导按钮，告诉用户下一步做什么。
demos.desc_en: When the list does not have data, use a slightly floating illustration + specify text + guide button to tell the user what to do next.

demos.title: 顶栏横幅
demos.desc: 页面顶部的提示条，从上方滑下；长文字可横向滚动，右侧有关闭按钮。
demos.desc_en: tab at the top of the page, slides from above; long text can scroll horizontally, with a closing button on the right.

demos.title: 颜色闪烁

demos.title: 翻转牌

demos.title: 进度环

demos.title: 打字机
demos.desc: 时间轴上每隔固定时间「多显示一个字」，看起来就像有人在打字；全部打完停 1 秒，再用一半的时间一个字一个字删掉。

demos.title: 视差层

demos.hint_en: Pointer left and right motion lens
demos.desc_en: The nearby trees retreated while the distant mountains moved slowly, and the brain was so close by the speed difference.

demos.title: 网格交错

demos.title: 噪声流体背景

demos.title: 等离子

demos.title: 光线步进融球
demos.desc: SDF 光线步进的融合球体与光照。
demos.desc_en: SDF light-lined integration sphere and light.

demos.title: 泰森多边形 Voronoi
demos.desc: 沃罗诺伊着色：每个像素找离它最近的种子点，按距离上色，形成细胞状色块。
demos.desc_en: Volonoy colours: each pixel looks for the nearest seed point to it, colours it above the distance, and forms a cell-shaped piece.

demos.title: 域扭曲
demos.desc: 先用噪声把坐标推来推去，再在扭曲后的坐标上画条纹/棋盘，规则图案就变成了流动的波纹。
demos.desc_en: You push the coordinates by noise, then draw stripes on the distorted coordinates / On board, the rule pattern becomes a flow of ripples.

demos.title: 螺旋
demos.desc: 把像素换成角度 θ 和半径 r，亮度取 sin(臂数·θ − 密度·r + t)，就得到旋转的螺旋臂。
demos.desc_en: Change pixels to angles θ And Radius r，Brightness sin(Arms · θ − Density ·  r + t)，Just get the spiral arm.

demos.title: 棋盘扭曲
demos.desc: floor(x)+floor(y) 的奇偶决定黑白；先用 sin 扭曲坐标，格子就会像布料一样波动。
demos.desc_en: floor(x)+floor(y) puppets decide black and white; first twist coordinates with sin and the grids fluctuate like fabric.

demos.title: 隧道
demos.desc: 用 1/r 当作深度 z、角度 θ 当作绕圈坐标，z 随时间增加，就像在管道里向前飞。
demos.desc_en: Use; to make use of; to employ 1/r Depth z、Angle θ As the circle coordinates, z Over time, it's like flying forward in a pipe.

demos.title: 涟漪
demos.desc: 每个波源发出圆形波 sin(距离/波长 − t)，离得越远越弱；多个波源叠加会出现干涉条纹。
demos.desc_en: Each wave source sends round waves sin (range) / A CWC

demos.title: 星野
demos.desc: 把画面切成网格，每格用哈希随机放一颗星；多层网格以不同速度平移形成视差，近处星大且快。
demos.desc_en: Cut the image into a grid, each with a single star randomly placed by Hash; multi- Production grids vary at different speeds to form a vision, with large and fast stars close.

demos.title: 熔岩
demos.desc: 若干团块上下漂浮，每个团块贡献 r²/d² 的「场」，场之和超过阈值的区域连成一片，团块靠近时会融合。
demos.desc_en: Several groups floating up and down, each contributing r²/d² The "fields", the fields and the areas above the threshold, are connected, and clusters will merge when they approach.

demos.title: 透视网格
demos.desc: 地平线以下用 1/|y| 做透视深度，深度随时间增加让网格向你滚来；上方是一轮带条纹缺口的太阳。
demos.desc_en: Use 1 below the horizon / |y| The depth of vision, which increases over time, allows the grid to roll over to you; above it is a round of suns with stripes.

demos.title: 万花筒
demos.desc: 把角度对「每瓣角度」取模再镜像，整个平面就由一小块扇形复制出 n 瓣对称图案。
demos.desc_en: The entire plane is copied by a small sector of n petal symmetry.

demos.title: HSV 色相旋转
demos.desc: 角度 = 色相 H，离中心距离 = 饱和度 S，整体亮度 = 明度 V。
demos.desc_en: Angle = colour H, distance from centre = saturation S, overall brightness = visibility V.

demos.title: 扫描线
demos.desc: 亮条从下往上扫过，身后留下指数衰减的余辉；背景是等间距的扫描线网格。
demos.desc_en: Light strips are cleaned up from the bottom, leaving behind them a residual of index decay; the background is a scanning grid with equal spacing.

demos.title: 双融球
demos.desc: 每个球产生 1/d 的场，场之和大于阈值就算「球体内部」，所以球靠近时边界平滑地连在一起。
demos.desc_en: Every ball produces 1/d In the field, the sum of the field is greater than the threshold, even if it is "the inner sphere of the sphere", so the borders are smoothly linked when the ball approaches.

demos.title: 体积雾
demos.desc: 多层噪声按不同速度沿风向飘动并叠加，越往下越浓；指针处像手电筒一样照亮雾气。
demos.desc_en: Multiple layers of noise float and collide along the wind at different speeds, deepening downwards; the pointer lights the fog like a flashlight.

demos.title: 流光条纹
demos.desc: 把坐标旋转到条纹方向，按宽度切成一条条，每条按序号取 n 种颜色之一；指针附近条纹会弯曲。
demos.desc_en: Rotates the coordinates to the stripe direction and cuts them in width into a strip, each of which takes one of the n colours by serial number; ADMINISTRATIVE stripes close to the pointer bend.

demos.title: SDF 距离场圆
demos.desc: 每个像素记录到圆边界的距离，内部为负、外部为正。
demos.desc_en: Each pixel records the distance to the circle boundary, negative inside, Externally positive.

demos.title: 水面
demos.desc: 多组不同方向、频率的正弦波叠加成水面高度，高度的峰值区域形成明亮的焦散光斑；指针拨动相位。
demos.desc_en: Multiple directions, The frequency sine wave superheaves into water surface heights, where the peak area forms a bright focal-dispersed spot; the pointer moves the phase.

demos.title: CRT 老电视
demos.desc: 画面先按像素块量化，再加横向扫描线、RGB 三通道错位（色差）和四角暗角，模拟老电视。
demos.desc_en: The image is quantified by pixels, followed by a horizontal scan, RGB Three-channel error (colour differential) and four-angle dark corner, simulation of old television.

demos.title: Julia 分形
demos.desc: 每个像素当作复数 z，反复做 z = z² + c，统计多少步后 |z| 超过 2（逃逸）。
demos.desc_en: Every pixel as a complex number z，Repeatedly z = z² + c，After how many steps? |z| Surpass 2（Run away.

demos.title: 飘雪
demos.desc: 每层把画面切成网格，每格放一片随机偏移的雪花并向下平移；近处层更大更快，风力让雪花倾斜飘落。
demos.desc_en: Each layer cuts the picture into a grid, each with a randomly shifting snowflake and moves downwards; the next layer is larger and faster, and wind forces the snowflakes down.

demos.title: 油画噪声
demos.desc: 坐标被「旋转 + 噪声偏移」反复迭代，每多一次图案越复杂，像油彩在水面上流动；彩虹膜模拟肥皂泡的干涉色。
demos.desc_en: The coordinates are "rotation + noise deflected" over and over, and the more complex the pattern each time, the more the paint flows on the water; the rainbow film simulates the interference colour of soap bubbles.

demos.desc: 细长的金色线段高速下落，落到底部溅起小火花；部分金粒带闪烁的十字星光。
demos.desc_en: The long gold segment is fast-defeating, with small sparks s Adviceing at the bottom; some of the gold pellets are flashing crosslights.

demos.title: 烟柱
demos.desc: 烟粒从底部烟源升起，随高度变大、变透明，并按扩散角向两侧散开；指针像风一样把烟吹偏。
demos.desc_en: Smoke rises Population rises from bottom to height, Transparent and spread across the sides by a proliferation angle; the pointer blows the smoke like the wind.

demos.title: 萤火
demos.desc: 每只沿两组不同频率的正弦曲线慢慢游荡（李萨如轨迹），亮度缓慢呼吸；指针附近的萤火虫会被吸引靠近。
demos.desc_en: Each swirling curve along two different frequencies (Lisa trajectories) moves slowly, and the brightness breathes slowly; fireflies close to the pointer are attracted closer.

demos.title: 火花喷泉
demos.desc: 每颗火花以随机角度和初速度喷出，之后受重力影响做抛物线运动，颜色由白热逐渐变暗。
demos.desc_en: Each spark ejected with a random angle and initial velocity, followed by a gravitational effect to act as parabolic motion, and the colour was darkened by white heat.

demos.title: 引力井
demos.desc: 每个粒子绕指针做圆周运动，引力越强轨道越小、转得越快（像行星：近的转得快）。
demos.desc_en: Each particle orbits around the pointer around, and the more gravity, the smaller it is, The faster it goes (like planets: the faster it goes).

demos.title: 排斥场
demos.desc: 粒子排成整齐网格，指针附近的粒子被推开，推力随距离衰减；离开后粒子弹回原位并轻轻呼吸。
demos.desc_en: The particles are drawn into a full grid, the particles near the pointer are pushed away and the thrust decreases with distance; the post-exit bullet returns to its original position and takes a light breath.

demos.title: 跟随群
demos.desc: 每个个体追随指针，但跟随有不同的延迟，并绕目标做小圆周运动，整体像一群小鱼/蜜蜂。
demos.desc_en: Each individual follows the pointer, but follows different delays and moves around the target in small circles, like a group. Small Fish / Bee.

demos.title: 爆炸碎屑
demos.desc: 三个错开时间的爆点，碎片从中心沿随机方向飞出，受阻力减速、受重力下坠，并逐渐熄灭；第一个爆点跟随指针。
demos.desc_en: Three staggered-time blast sites, debris coming out of the center in a random direction and slowing down, Gravity falls and gradually dies; the first blast point follows the pointer.

demos.title: 螺旋星系
demos.desc: 星点沿对数螺旋分布在几条旋臂上，越靠内转得越快（差速旋转），中心是明亮的核球；指针让星系倾斜。
demos.hint_en: Rotating the arm of the galaxy
demos.desc_en: The star point is distributed along a logarithmic spiral over several spiral arms, and the faster it moves in (distant rotation), the centre being a bright nuclear ball; the pointer tilts the galaxy.

demos.title: 心形场
demos.desc: 粒子分布在心形曲线附近，整体按心跳节奏缩放（快速放大、缓慢回落）；指针靠近时粒子被轻轻推开。
demos.desc_en: The particles are distributed near the heart curve, and the whole body is scaled by the rhythm of the heartbeat (quick zooming), Slow down; particles are gently pushed away when the pointer approaches.

demos.title: 文字点阵
demos.desc: 先把文字画到离屏画布，再每隔几个像素采样一次，有颜色的位置就放一个粒子；粒子在目标位置附近微微浮动，指针靠近…
demos.desc_en: Draw the text to the screen canvas, then sample it every few pixels, and put a particle in colour; the particle floats slightly near the target position, the pointer approaches

demos.title: 网格跳动
demos.desc: 从指针位置发出一圈圈圆形波，波峰经过的点会放大变亮，像水面上的浮标随波起伏。
demos.desc_en: A circle of circular waves is sent from the pointer position, and the points through which the peak passes magnify and brighten, as the buoys on the water rise and fall.

demos.title: 波浪粒子
demos.desc: 粒子排成多行，每行沿正弦波上下起伏，行与行之间相位错开形成 3D 起伏的海面；指针位置的波浪更高。
demos.desc_en: The particles are lined in multiple rows, each line rises up and down along the sine wave, staggering between the rows into a 3D up and down surface; the wave at the pointer position is higher.

demos.title: 彗星
demos.desc: 每颗彗星沿斜线划过天空，尾巴由许多逐渐变小变淡的粒子组成，是彗星头部过去位置的轨迹。
demos.desc_en: Each comet cuts through the sky along an oscillating line, and the tail is made up of many small and faded particles that are the trajectory of the past position of the head of the comet.

demos.title: 泡泡上升
demos.desc: 气泡从底部浮起，左右摆动上升，越接近顶部越透明；指针碰到的气泡会被推开。
demos.desc_en: The bubble rises from the bottom, the right and left swings up, and the closer to the top, the more transparent it becomes; the bubble that the pointer touches will be pushed away.

demos.title: 落叶
demos.desc: 叶片缓慢下落，同时左右大幅摇摆并绕自身旋转；叶片形状是两段圆弧拼成的椭圆叶。
demos.desc_en: The leaves are slowly falling, while the right and left are rocked and rotated around themselves; the shape of the leaves is an elliptical leaf spelled out in two arcs.

demos.title: 沙尘
demos.desc: 一束斜射的光从左上照进来，飘浮的尘埃在光束里被照亮，在光束外几乎看不见；光束随指针摆动。
demos.desc_en: A slanted light comes in from the left, and the floating dust is lighted in the beam, almost invisible outside the beam; the beam moves with the pointer.

demos.title: 霓虹点
demos.desc: 发光的点在画面里漂移，两点距离小于「连线距离」时画一条线，越近线越亮；色相随位置缓慢变化。
demos.desc_en: The point of light drifts in the image, drawing a line at a distance less than the "connected distance" and the closer the line becomes brighter; the color changes slowly with the position.

demos.title: 量子抖
demos.desc: 原子核在中心，电子沿倾斜的椭圆轨道运动；电子云扩散越大，每个电子周围的「概率云」粒子越分散，体现量子的不确定性。
demos.desc_en: The atomic nucleus is at the centre, with electrons moving along an oscillating elliptical orbit; the more the electron clouds spread, the more the `probability cloud' particles around each electron spread, reflecting the uncertainty of quantum.

demos.title: 连接网
demos.desc: 节点在画面中缓慢漂移，距离近的节点连线；指针是一个特殊的「枢纽」，会把附近节点轻轻吸过来并全部连线。
demos.desc_en: Authorized to move slowly in the image and connect to the nearest node; the pointer is a special "junction" that will suffocate the nearby node lightly and connect all of it.

demos.title: 黑洞吸积
demos.desc: 粒子组成扁平的吸积盘绕中心旋转，越靠内转得越快、越热越亮（开普勒运动），中间的事件视界是一个纯黑圆；指针让盘…
demos.desc_en: The more the particles rotate around the flat suction center, the faster they move inside, The hotter it gets, the more bright it gets

demos.title: 彩虹喷泉
demos.desc: 粒子沿多层同心圆弧排成彩虹，每一层的色相 = 主色色相 + 层号 × 跨度 / 层数；粒子沿弧线流动，指针位…
demos.desc_en: The particles line up multilayer concentric arcs into rainbows, each layer of color = Main color + Layer × Span / layers; particles flow along arc lines, point point points…

categories.intro_en: A Canvas particle kit: starfields, snow, smoke, gravity fields and more, with tunable variants.

categories.name: 生成艺术
categories.intro: 程序化生成图案：噪声场、细胞自动机、递归分形与随机游走。

demos.title: Perlin 噪声流场
demos.desc: 画面每一点都有一个「风向」，由平滑噪声决定。
demos.desc_en: There is a "wind direction" at every point in the picture, determined by smooth noise.

demos.title: Julia 分形集
demos.desc: Julia 集：每个点反复做 z = z² + c，数它多少步后跑远，按步数上色。
demos.desc_en: Julia Episode: Every point repeats z = z² + c，Count how many steps it takes to run away, and by the colours.

demos.title: 曼德博集合
demos.desc: 对每个点 c，从 z = 0 开始反复做 z ← z² + c，看会不会逃到无穷远。
demos.desc_en: To every point c，From; through; via z = 0 Start doing it again and again z ← z² + c，Plans are underway.

demos.title: 康威生命游戏
demos.desc: 生命游戏：每个格子看周围 8 个邻居，活邻居 2~3 个就活下去，正好 3 个就出生。
demos.desc_en: Life game: each grid looks around 8 A neighbor. Live neighbor 2~3 Just live. That's it 3 One is born.

demos.title: 沃罗诺伊
demos.desc: 撒下若干「种子」点，画面上每个位置都归属离它最近的种子，于是平面被分成一块块区域。
demos.desc_en: Several "seeds" were scattered, each location on the image belonged to the nearest seed, and the plane was divided into blocks.

demos.title: 递归树
demos.desc: 画一根树枝，然后在末端左右各画一根更短的树枝，再对每根新树枝重复同样的事——这就是「递归」。
demos.desc_en: Draw a branch, then draw a shorter branch around the end, and repeat the same thing for Comparison.

demos.title: 谢尔宾斯基三角
demos.desc: 把一个三角形三条边的中点连起来，挖掉中间那个，剩下 3 个小三角；再对每个小三角重复。
demos.desc_en: Connect a triangle to the middle of the three sides. Dig the middle one 3 Small triangles; repeat each.

demos.title: 圆形填充
demos.desc: 随机选一个点，算出它离最近的圆和边框还有多远，就在那里放一个刚好不重叠的圆；重复很多次，大圆先占位，小圆填缝。
demos.desc_en: Select a random dot to calculate how far it is from the nearest circle and frame, where it is placed in a circle that happens to be non-overlapping; repeat it many times, with the big dot first, with the small dome filled.

demos.title: 噪声地形
demos.desc: 把平滑噪声当作「海拔」，一行行横着取样画成折线，远处的线在上、近处在下，并用纯色遮住后面的线，就形成有前后遮…
demos.desc_en: The smooth noise is used as an "alt", a line of cross-sampling lines, and the line is on, Close to the bottom, with pure colours covering the lines behind them, they form back and forth

demos.title: 随机游走
demos.desc: 每个游走者每一步随机选上、下、左、右之一走一步，像醉汉走路。
demos.desc_en: Every swimmer picks at random Comoros, Down, Left, One step right, like a drunk walking.

demos.title: L 系统植物
demos.desc: 从字符串 "F" 开始，按规则把每个 F 替换成一串更长的指令，反复几次；然后让「海龟」照着画：F 前进画线…
demos.desc_en: Start with the string "F" and replace each F with a series of longer commands, repeated several times; then let the Sea Turtle paint: F Forward Line

demos.title: 波纹干涉
demos.desc: 每个波源发出一圈圈圆形波。
demos.desc_en: Each wave source sends a circle of circular waves.

demos.title: 染色扩散
demos.desc: 两种「化学物质」A 和 B 在格子里扩散并反应（A + 2B → 3B），A 不断被补充，B 不断被移除。
demos.desc_en: Two "Chemicals" A and B spread and react in cells (A + 2B → 3B), A is constantly being added and B is being removed.

demos.title: 马赛克噪声
demos.desc: 把画面切成方砖，每块砖取中心点的噪声值，再按「色阶数」四舍五入成几档颜色（量化）。
demos.desc_en: Cut the image into square bricks, take the noise value of each brick from the centre, and round it to the "chromatic steps" rounded to the nearest colours.

demos.title: 极坐标花
demos.desc: 用「角度 θ + 半径 r」来画图。
demos.desc_en: Use angle θ + Radius r」Come and draw.

demos.title: 三角剖分
demos.desc: 在网格上放顶点，并让每个顶点随噪声轻轻抖动；每个方格沿对角线切成两个三角形。
demos.desc_en: Puts a vertebrae on the grid and allows each vertebrae to shake with the noise; each square cuts into two triangles along the diagonal line.

demos.title: 方块细分
demos.desc: 把一个矩形沿长边切成两块，再对每块重复，直到达到深度或随机决定停下。
demos.desc_en: Cuts a rectangle along the long edge into two pieces and repeats each of them until they reach depth or decide to stop at random.

demos.title: 等高线
demos.desc: 把噪声值当作地图上的高度，在高度恰好等于 1/n、2/n… 的地方画线，就像地图上的等高线。
demos.desc_en: Use the noise value as the height on the map 1/n、2/n… It's like a line on a map.

demos.title: 墨水滴
demos.desc: 一滴墨落入水中会向外扩散，半径增长越来越慢（约 ∝ √时间），颜色一圈圈分层，边缘因水流轻微抖动，最后淡去。
demos.desc_en: A drop of ink in water spreads out, and the radius is growing slowly ∝ √Time) , one circle of colour, with the edge dimmed by the current.

demos.title: 光纤束
demos.desc: 一束光纤从底部同一点散开，每根是一条二次贝塞尔曲线，控制点随风摆动并被指针吸引。
demos.desc_en: A line of fibers spreads from the bottom to the same point, each with a double Bézier curve, and the control point moves with the wind and is attracted by the pointer.

demos.title: 像素排序感
demos.desc: 逐行扫描图片，把亮度超过阈值的连续一段像素按亮度从暗到亮重新排列，就会出现被「拉丝」的效果。
demos.desc_en: A line-by-line scan of a picture that rearranges a series of pixels with a brightness above the threshold from the dark to the brightness will have the effect of being "Raz."

demos.title: 细胞增长
demos.desc: 每个细胞长大后一分为二，两个子细胞沿随机方向分开，体积各占一半（半径 ÷ √2）。
demos.desc_en: Each cell grows up in two, two subcells are separated in a random direction, each in half size (radi Ratified) ÷ √2）。

demos.title: 引力绘线
demos.desc: 一组水平直线，像时空网格；画面上有 2 个绕圈运动的「质量」加上指针，每个质量都把附近的线点拉向自己，越近拉…
demos.desc_en: A horizontal line, like a time grid; on the image 2 The "mass" of a circular motion plus the pointer, each of which pulls itself closer to the point in the vicinity…

demos.title: 螺旋采样
demos.desc: 第 i 个点放在半径 √i、角度 i × 发散角 的位置。
demos.desc_en: I don't think so i Point in radius √i、Angle i × Spread out Location.

categories.intro_en: Procedurally generated patterns: noise fields, cellular automata, recursive fractals and random walks.

categories.name: 文字特效
categories.intro: 打字机、故障、渐变、描边、拆分入场等文字动效，逐字在画布上排版与动画，悬停读出每个字的状态。

demos.title: 打字机
demos.desc: 文字一个个出现，后面跟着闪烁的光标；打完停顿一会儿，再逐字删除，循环往复。
demos.desc_en: The text appears one by one, followed by a blinking cursor; after a pause, delete it word for word, and recycle.

demos.title: 故障风文字
demos.desc: 模仿信号干扰——把文字切成横条随机左右错位，并把红、青两个颜色通道错开。
demos.desc_en: imitation of signal interference -- cutting text into strips and randomly misdirected and red, The two colour channels are staggered.

demos.title: 渐变扫光
demos.desc: 文字用一条横向的颜色渐变来填充，渐变不断平移形成流动感；再叠加一条倾斜的白色高光从左扫到右，像金属反光。
demos.desc_en: The text is filled with a horizontal colour gradient, which is smoothing to create a sense of movement; and a tilted white high light is plowed from the left to the right, like a metal reflection.

demos.title: 描边填充
demos.desc: 先只画文字的轮廓线（strokeText），并向右下错开叠几层形成立体阴影；然后实心颜色从左往右「灌」进文字…
demos.desc_en: First draw a contour of text (strokeText) and stagger several layers to the bottom right to form a stereo shadow; then solid colours "push" from left to right into text

demos.title: 拆分下落
demos.desc: 把一句话拆成单个字，每个字依次从上方落下，落地时带一点弹跳；停留片刻后再逐个向下掉出画面，循环。
demos.desc_en: Split a sentence into a single word, with each word falling from above, with a bit of a jump on the ground; and then drop the picture down one by one after a moment.

demos.title: 弹性弹入
demos.desc: 每个字从 0 放大到原尺寸，因为「弹性」会先超过原尺寸再回弹几次才停下，像果冻。
demos.desc_en: Each word is zoomed in from 0 to its original size, because "flexible" will go beyond the original size and bounce back several times before stopping, like Jell-O.

demos.title: 模糊清晰
demos.desc: 每个字一开始又糊又淡，然后依次变得清晰锐利，像镜头对焦；停留后再从左到右重新变糊。
demos.desc_en: Each word begins with a dull beginning, and then becomes clear and sharp, like a lens to focus; then it stops and then changes from left to right.

demos.title: 镜像翻转
demos.desc: 每个字绕水平轴依次翻转一圈（纵向缩放从 1 → −1 → 1），下方还有一个上下颠倒、逐渐变淡的倒影，像站在…
demos.desc_en: One turn in turn per word horizontal axis (vertical scaling from 1 →1 →1) and one upside down below Here, A faded reflection, like standing

demos.title: 波浪字
demos.desc: 每个字的上下位置是一条正弦波，后面的字比前面的字晚一点（相位差），连起来就像一排在水面上起伏的浮标。
demos.desc_en: The top and bottom of each word is a sine wave, followed by a little later than the previous word (phase difference), which is linked to a line of buoys that rise and fall on the water.

demos.title: 3D 透视
demos.desc: 文字写在一张向后倒下的平面上，平面不断往远处移动。
demos.desc_en: The text is written on a backwards-down plane, which continues to move far away.

demos.title: 霓虹灯管
demos.desc: 文字用细线描边当作灯管，再加上同色的大范围模糊阴影（shadowBlur）当作光晕。
demos.desc_en: The text is used as a light pipe with a liner, plus the same colour with a wide-scale blur (shadowBlur) as light.

demos.title: 打散重组
demos.desc: 所有字从各自的位置飞散到随机方向并旋转，然后再沿原路飞回拼成原句，循环。
demos.hint_en: Spread out and get together again
demos.desc_en: All words are dispersed from their respective positions in a random direction and rotated, and then removed back to the original sentence, looping.

demos.title: 计数滚动
demos.desc: 每一位数字是一条竖着的 0~9 纸带，数值增加时最低位持续滚动；当低位从 9 滚到 0 的那一刻，高一位才跟…
demos.desc_en: Each number is a vertical 0-9 tape, the lowest level continues to scroll when the value increases; when the lower position goes from nine to zero, the upper one follows

demos.title: 密码解码
demos.desc: 文字先显示为不断变化的乱码字符，然后从左到右一个个「破译」成真正的字，像电影里的黑客界面。
demos.desc_en: The text is first displayed as a continuously changing charade, and then from the left to the right, a "decipher" becomes a real word, like the hacker interface in the movie.

demos.title: 打印色带
demos.desc: 模仿小票打印机——打印头从左到右扫过当前行把字印出来，印完一行纸带向上走一行。
demos.desc_en: Simulates a small ticket printer - the head of the printing is scrutinised through the current line, and a line of paper is printed upwards.

demos.title: 手写进度
demos.desc: 用虚线技巧画字的轮廓——把虚线的「实线段」从 0 慢慢加长到整条轮廓长度，看起来就像笔在一笔笔描字；每个字描…
demos.desc_en: Painting the contours of the word with a dotted line technique -- extending the "real segment" of the dotted line slowly from 0 to the length of the contours, looking like a pen in a pen; every word

demos.title: 字幕卡拉OK
demos.desc: 当前唱到的那一行，颜色像进度条一样从左往右「刷」过去，刷过的字变成高亮色并发光；唱完一行切换到下一行，上下行…
demos.desc_en: In the line that you're singing, the color goes from left to right "brush" and the brushes turn to bright color and light; after the line goes to the next line, go up and down

demos.title: 竖排滚动
